connectome.sugar_knn.fitted_to: leave-one-out classification of the left LB3 neurons (Shiu sugar vs other) on FlyWire v783; k=5 gave 19/20 sugar, 2/44 false positives (Synaptera v1 selection, anatomy only)

connectome.nt_modulatory.source: dopamine, serotonin and octopamine act as slow neuromodulators; the Shiu model nevertheless treats them as fast excitation. connectome.pred_sign_shiu.source: Shiu et al. 2023 model rule: every transmitter other than GABA / glutamate is excitatory; used by the 'impute' variant to give a predicted neuron its vote. HIST and TYR (BANC) have no entry on purpose: F1 decision

connectome.fast_nt_sign.source: Shiu et al. 2023 sign mapping for the three fast transmitters (ACh excitatory; GABA, glutamate inhibitory); applied to the literature transmitter of Schlegel et al. 2024 known_nt by the 'literature' variant

readouts.readout_types.source: readout cell types of v1 (SPEC_BRAIN_CONTROL R2): steering DNa02 / DNp15 (DNa02: ipsilateral turning in walking, Rayshubskiy et al.; DNp15: HS/H2 one hop), proboscis MN9, looming DNp01/02/04/11/06, landing DNp07/10, contralateral looming DNa01/DNb01, optic flow DNp20/DNb06, DNa03. The v1 post-hoc choice of DNp15 as the only yaw drive is NOT inherited: a drive type must pass the symmetry gate

readouts.steer_types.source: readout cell types of v1 (SPEC_BRAIN_CONTROL R2): steering DNa02 / DNp15 (DNa02: ipsilateral turning in walking, Rayshubskiy et al.; DNp15: HS/H2 one hop), proboscis MN9, looming DNp01/02/04/11/06, landing DNp07/10, contralateral looming DNa01/DNb01, optic flow DNp20/DNb06, DNa03. The v1 post-hoc choice of DNp15 as the only yaw drive is NOT inherited: a drive type must pass the symmetry gate

readouts.readout_tau.source: readout low-pass time constant (v1 VARSAYIM): one DN at 10 Hz gives 0.25 spikes per 25 ms step, so without a filter the decision flickers from single spikes; ~ the duration of a flight saccade / proboscis extension onset; not fitted

readouts.mn9_threshold_hz.source: proboscis-extension threshold of the MN9 decision (FlyGym has no proboscis joint; the extension is recorded, it has no physical effect)
readouts.mn9_threshold_hz.fitted_to: the MN9 mean rate at the upper end of the GRN transition of the open-loop R0 curve (v783, Shiu protocol: sugar GRN 20 Hz -> 0/0, 50 Hz -> 11.2/8.2, 100 Hz -> 59.6/46.8 Hz): (11.2 + 8.2)/2 = 9.7 -> 10 Hz; open-loop physiology only

readouts.k_steer.source: yaw readout gain (v1 VARSAYIM, unchanged): a normalised excess of one reference mean on the left gives delta Phi = 10 deg, steady yaw ~5 rad/s; sign: a DN more active on the left turns the fly to the LEFT (ipsilateral), as DNa02 in walking

readouts.turn_bias_max.source: yaw readout gain (v1 VARSAYIM, unchanged): a normalised excess of one reference mean on the left gives delta Phi = 10 deg, steady yaw ~5 rad/s; sign: a DN more active on the left turns the fly to the LEFT (ipsilateral), as DNa02 in walking

connectome.innorm_clip.source: engineering guard of the per-neuron input normalisation (prereg/05 section 2.1): the factor s = FlyWire / BANC mean input synapses of the neuron's type is clipped to [0.25, 4]; the per-neuron s itself is origin P (computed from data only, not fitted to any rate)

f3b1.rate_gain.fitted_to: open-loop VNC dose-response (F3a-3) and FlyWire F0 rates (C1)
f3b1.rate_gain.source: prereg/09 section 6: g_f = lowest steering input rate of family f on the BANC VNC subgraph (docs/results/f3a3_vnc_subgraph.json r3.lowest_rate) / median FlyWire F0 flight-window per-neuron rate of f (docs/results/f3a2_checks.json c1.f0.<f>.flight.median); no behaviour used

f3b1.bridge_window_intervals.source: prereg/09 section 5: trailing window of the per-neuron mean DN rate in coupling/dn_bridge.py; equal to the 25 ms readout bin used since v1

f3b1.bridge_latency_intervals.source: docs/07 section 3 and the owner's answer (docs/05, after PR #12): the FlyWire rate of interval k is applied in interval k+1 (CLAUDE.md rule 4); 0 is the ACAUSAL variant

model_v2.adapt_a.source: Brette & Gerstner 2005, J Neurophysiol 94:3637-3642, doi 10.1152/jn.00686.2005, Table 1 (aEIF parameters: g_L 30 nS, a 4 nS, b 0.0805 nA, tau_w 144 ms); general value: no fitted Drosophila AdEx parameters were found (owner rule: cited general value, origin P); converted to the voltage form of the Shiu equation by dividing by g_L

model_v2.adapt_b_v.source: Brette & Gerstner 2005, J Neurophysiol 94:3637-3642, doi 10.1152/jn.00686.2005, Table 1 (aEIF parameters: g_L 30 nS, a 4 nS, b 0.0805 nA, tau_w 144 ms); general value: no fitted Drosophila AdEx parameters were found (owner rule: cited general value, origin P); spike-triggered jump of the adaptation variable in volts, b / g_L = 2.683 mV

model_v2.adapt_tau_w_s.source: Brette & Gerstner 2005, J Neurophysiol 94:3637-3642, doi 10.1152/jn.00686.2005, Table 1 (aEIF parameters: g_L 30 nS, a 4 nS, b 0.0805 nA, tau_w 144 ms); general value: no fitted Drosophila AdEx parameters were found (owner rule: cited general value, origin P)

model_v2.e_exc_v.source: reversal potential of the excitatory (cholinergic, cation) conductance; project owner's value (2026-10-14), the standard value for nicotinic receptors

model_v2.e_inh_v.source: chloride reversal potential of adult Drosophila flight motoneuron MN5, -74 +- 4 mV (sharp electrode, GABA puffs): Ryglewski, Vonhoff, Scheckel & Duch 2017, Neuron 93:632-645, doi 10.1016/j.neuron.2016.12.043, Fig. 4C,E. Used for GABA (Rdl) and glutamate (GluCl) synapses, both chloride channels; measured in one cell type and applied to every neuron

model_v2.dg_exc.fitted_to: peak PSP of ONE excitatory synapse at rest (v_0 = -52 mV) equals the peak PSP of one Shiu synapse (w_syn 0.275 mV, tau 5 ms, t_mbr 20 ms): 0.04331 mV; owner's criterion (2026-10-14); computed by engine/model_variants.py:calibrate_dg without any network run

model_v2.dg_inh.fitted_to: peak PSP of ONE inhibitory synapse at rest (v_0 = -52 mV) equals the peak PSP of one Shiu synapse (w_syn 0.275 mV, tau 5 ms, t_mbr 20 ms): 0.04331 mV; owner's criterion (2026-10-14); computed by engine/model_variants.py:calibrate_dg without any network run

model_v2.gap_dv_v.source: instantaneous jump of the postsynaptic v at each presynaptic spike of a registered electrical synapse; equal to the model's own suprathreshold kick w_syn * f_poi (Shiu: '250 is sufficient to cause spiking'). Engineering realisation of the measured property of the GF-TTMn / GF-PSI junctions: 1:1 transmission with < 1 ms latency, lost in shakB2 (Phelan et al. 2008 Curr Biol 18:1955, Fig. 3K-M; Tanouye & Wyman 1980). The point model has no spike waveform, so a coupling conductance cannot be applied to it

model_v2.gap_min_chemical_synapses.source: configs/gap_junctions.yaml pairing rule: a registered pre cell is coupled to every post cell of the registered type on which it has >= 1 chemical synapse (mixed electrochemical synapses)
